title: Lagged U.S. CPI year-over-year disinflation for BTC long or cash
thesis: A conservatively lagged monthly decline in U.S. CPI year-over-year inflation may identify easing monetary-policy pressure with better subsequent Bitcoin risk-adjusted economics than months when year-over-year inflation is flat or accelerating.
mechanism: Using only the sealed present-vintage CPIAUCSL monthly index, compute CPI_t divided by CPI_t-minus-12 minus one and compare it with the immediately prior month's analogous year-over-year rate. Make the state usable on the first day of the second following month at 00:00 UTC. Hold full-capital unlevered BTC only when the current year-over-year rate is strictly lower, and zero-yield cash otherwise. No core CPI, PCE, surprise, level, magnitude, smoothing, alternate lag, inverse direction or combined factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If disinflation reduces the expected tightening burden on risky assets, the policy may avoid inflation-pressure drawdowns while retaining enough BTC upside to improve matched-capital Calmar after explicit normal and doubled friction. Because Bitcoin's inflation relationship is regime-dependent, Design, Validation, annual breadth, episode concentration and terminal inventory must all pass.
